description:
Title: Systems Software Programmer 
 Location: COLUMBIA, South Carolina 
 Duration: 12 months 
 
 Required Skills (Rank in Order Of Importance): 
 The successful candidate will have, at minimum, the following skills:
 • Experience and expertise in software installation and implementation.
 • Experience in configuration management.
 • Experience and expertise in hardware and software testing; familiarity with testing methodologies and preparation of test plans.
 • Experience and expertise to troubleshoot application and windows servers.
 • Experience and expertise in isolation and diagnosis of hardware and software defects, including use of diagnostic tools such as monitors and traces.
 • Proficiency in Java environments under Windows. 
 • Expert knowledge of databases and relational database concepts. Experience with SQL Server 2014/2016 required.
 • Experience with Windows 7/8/10 operating systems and the Windows 2008/2012 server environments.
 • Experience with Data Warehouse concepts, including techniques for handling very large databases.
 • Ability to communicate clearly and concisely, both orally and in writing. 
 • Ability to establish and maintain good working relationships with business users, management, vendors, and peers. 
 • Strong organizational, multi-tasking, and time-management skills. Ability to complete assignments on time. 
 • Understanding of deployment methodology concepts including design, build, testing, and deployment.
 Preferred Skills (Rank In Order Of Importance): 
 • Experienced with requirements / environments of PCI, PUB1075, NIST.
 • Experience with regulatory compliance management for a Data Warehouse environment.
 • Experience with Wildfly a plus. 
 • Expertise with source code management – Microsoft Team Foundation Server.


 All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.
